svg.title: Words by the fire: AI, code and GitHub terms as pixel icons
svg.desc: A grid of 30 single-colour pixel icons in fire orange on night green, each in a coloured frame and labelled with its word: LLM, Token, Context window, Prompt, System prompt, Temperature, Hallucination, Training, Fine-tuning, RAG, Embedding, Agent, Tool use, MCP, API, Open weights, Local model, GPU, Multimodal, AGI, Repository, Commit, Branch, Pull request, Merge, Actions, Deploy, Fork, Issue, Organization.
